system.description:
Suasion is the verbal art of the priest. It is used to enlighten the benighted. This skill allows a Priest to convince others to act on his behalf (because it is in the best interest of their immortal souls). It is a Persuasion skill for the clergy.

Obstacles: Obstacle: Will of the victim. This skill may also be used in the Duel of Wits.

FoRKs: Soothing Platitudes, Falsehood

Skill Type: Social. Tools: No.

Root: Will

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 302
